description: This file defines a utility class 'Formatters' with static methods for formatting currency, dates, and times, using the intl package.

classes.name: Formatters
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for formatting currency, dates, and times.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Formats a double value as currency using US locale and dollar symbol.

methods.name: compactCurrency
methods.description: Formats a double value as a compact currency string for charts and badges.

methods.name: dateShort
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a short date string.

methods.name: dateTimeMedium
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a medium date and time string.
